scenes.label: VALKEY
scenes.title: Valkey
scenes.headline: NOT just a cache.
lines: all in memory, all insanely fast
scenes.narration: This is Valkey. Most people know it as a cache, but caching is just a small part of the story.

scenes.label: CACHING
scenes.headline: Caching
scenes.narration: Instead of hitting the database every single time, Valkey keeps the result in memory and serves it back in microseconds.

scenes.label: DATA TYPES
scenes.headline: The data structures
rows: objects — a user profile in one key
scenes.narration: Strings store text and numbers. Hashes hold objects, like a user profile. And lists keep things in order — that's your job queue.

scenes.label: THAT'S VALKEY
scenes.title: Valkey
scenes.narration: So that's Valkey. What would you build with it? Tell me in the comments, and hit like if this helped.
